alternatives.name: DHT22
alternatives.note: Same sensor family, ±0.5°C / ±2% RH — usually worth the small price difference.

alternatives.name: AHT20
alternatives.note: I²C, smaller, more accurate, cheaper — recommended for new designs.

name: DHT11
tips: DHT11 is the cheap variant — wide tolerance, integer resolution.
Single-wire protocol is timing-critical; can be unreliable on FreeRTOS without disabling interrupts during read.
If you need accuracy, use DHT22 instead.

pins.label: NC
pins.note: Not connected on 3-pin modules; tie to GND on bare-chip 4-pin
